codeReview.summary: The implementation satisfies the follow-up intent by documenting the git-worktree dependency in all of the shared setup surfaces that workers are expected to read before startup or validation. The changes are narrowly scoped to documentation/config comments, preserve the existing portable root-resolution approach, and do not introduce any codepath or service-manifest regressions.

summary: Pass. Commit cbc6cc3 correctly documents that the manifest web service derives its root with git rev-parse and therefore must be run from within a git worktree. No blocking or non-blocking implementation issues were found, and no additional shared-state gaps were identified from this feature review.
